column1: # THE RECORD BANDS: every fidelity row one daily record can be read the model's way, with that
# record's own sampling spread -- where the statistic lands over moving one-year-block resamples of
# the record.  A verdict row that carries a band is judged by where the model falls between p5 and
# p95 and reports that percentile, and its `real` is this file's `record`.  `RecordBandSuite` /
# `record_band_tests` re-derive the shipped `RecordBand` literals and the typical-year anchors from
# this file.  Editing a row moves the shipped bands.
# record     the row's statistic on the whole window, by `seriesReadings` / `series_readings`: the
#            functions the model reads a path with.  The typical year's is `yearVolPhaseMean`, the
#            median-year vol averaged over all 252 block phases: on one series the phase is worth as
#            much as the gap the row measures (QQQ 18.2 to 21.5; calendar years, which the anchor
# p0..p100   the statistic over 20000 resamples, each the window's own length, built from whole
#            252-session blocks at uniformly drawn starts (`NumPyRng`, seed 20260918) and read the
# nasdaq  QQQ, folio's cached Yahoo adjusted closes: daily log returns 1999-03-11..2026-08-20, the
#         window the Nasdaq set's levels were measured over.  The file's first row is the anchor
# sp500   CRSP value-weighted US market total return from Ken French's
#         F-F_Research_Data_Factors_daily (202606): Mkt-RF + RF compounded into an index without a
#         leading 1.0, then its log returns, so the window's first session drops out.  1954-2026
#         for every row but clustering, which the set reads over the century, 1926-2026.
# WHERE A LOSS TARGET IS NOT THIS RECORD, and stays as it is (the verdict carries both):
#   variance ratio 60d     1.00 in both sets, a theory value: the model has no mean-reversion
#   sp500 equity vol %     16.0, a pre-0.21 literal; 1954-2026 reads 15.68
#   sp500 kurtosis         28, the century's; the row reads 1954-2026, 21.8
#   sp500 crashes/century  20.7, between the century's 19.2 and 1954-2026's 24.9
#   sp500 median depth %   -21.4, the mean of the two middle episodes of 18; the model's median
#   nasdaq downside        1.13, an earlier vintage of the same series; this window reads 1.07
#       -from 1954-01-04 -to 2026-06-30 -rows <every row but the two clustering rows>
